notes.title: Update 1.2 (Easier Easy mode)
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Just a quick update, we made the track a slower based on the difficulty you choose. So now instead of just getting more slow downs, you also get a slower track. 

Easy mode is actually easy now. ;) ːpowerorbː

notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.content:
Hello everyone! I'm glad to hear you all are enjoying Roomscale Coaster.

We've listened to your feedback and have changed/added a few things.

Changelist:

Added haptic feedback for collecting orbs.

Increased sound fx of collecting orbs.

Readjusted the hands. 

Rearranged the menus to be easier to use.

Fixed a glitch that caused the difficulty and comfort mode to be changed when you clicked "Retry". 


Please let me know if you run into anymore issues, and most of all, have fun!
